versions.subject: rule: suspicious schtasks rule
versions.detection:
selection_create:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' /create '
selection_command:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - 'powershell'
        - 'cmd /c '
        - 'cmd.exe /c '
selection1_all_folders:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        - '%ProgramData%'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="* /create *" CommandLine IN ("*powershell*", "*cmd /c *", "*cmd.exe /c *") CommandLine IN ("*C:\\ProgramData\\*", "*%ProgramData%*")
